research_result.description: QuickBooks Online provides financial management APIs with REST and GraphQL support, enabling applications to interact with accounting data such as invoices, customers, bills, and reports. Intuit provides official open-source and hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enable AI agents to directly interact with QuickBooks data.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can create a free Intuit Developer account and generate sandbox credentials immediately along with test companies. Obtaining live production client credentials requires submitting and receiving approval for the Production Key questionnaire/App Assessment checklist.

evidence.claim: QuickBooks uses OAuth 2.0 as its primary API authorization standard.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: When you’re ready to authorize your production app, connect it to the Intuit OAuth 2.0 server. OAuth 2.0 is Intuit’s standard authorization protocol.

evidence.claim: QuickBooks supports OpenID Connect for single sign-on authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: If you also need to implement single sign-on, you can add OpenID Connect later on.

evidence.claim: QuickBooks Online Accounting API supports both REST and GraphQL.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The QuickBooks Online Accounting API uses both the REST framework, with standard HTTP methods and JSON for input and output, and GraphQL.

evidence.claim: Developers can sign up for a free developer account and create sandbox companies.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Go to the Intuit Developer Portal and create a developer account. You’ll be asked to enter some basic company information and a name for your workspace.

evidence.claim: Production API keys require completing a questionnaire and receiving Intuit approval.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The client ID and client secret will be accessible only after completing the Production Key questionnaire and its approval.

evidence.claim: An official open-source QuickBooks Online MCP server is available.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The QuickBooks MCP Server lets AI assistants access QuickBooks data via a standard interface.

evidence.claim: Intuit provides a hosted MCP server endpoint for AI pilot partners.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Connect AI agents and LLM-powered apps to QuickBooks Online through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
